Cost +1 Vitae

Area 10-foot burst

When you apply a Graft's effect, you may instead apply it to every creature in a 10-foot burst centered on a point within the Graft's normal range, at 1 additional Vitae cost. Grafts requiring an attack roll instead require one attack roll per target in the burst; Grafts requiring a save use the same DC against every target.
